tagline: Enterprise Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformation partner for the Fortune 1000.
hero_kpi_rationale: Grid Dynamics positions itself as an AI transformation partner for Fortune 1000 enterprises, combining deep AI expertise with proven enterprise-scale delivery. Revenue generated by these AI and cloud transformations is the primary driver of their strategic growth and reflects rising demand for digital transformation services.

kpis.name: AI/Cloud Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by projects and services related to artificial intelligence and cloud for large enterprises.
kpis.description: Total revenues increased 17.5% year-over-year to reach $411.8 million, driven by demand across core verticals and acquisition contributions.
kpis.signal: Solid revenue growth driven by strong AI transformation demand.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deduction of cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin decreased from 36.2% in 2024 to 34.6% in 2025, indicating pricing or cost pressures in service delivery.
kpis.signal: Slight erosion in gross margin reflects cost pressures.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Loss from operations narrowed to $1.9 million (-0.5% of revenue) in 2025 compared to $2.1 million (-0.6%) in 2024, showing improving operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Operating loss narrowing as revenue growth outpaces expense growth.

kpis.name: Recurring/Subscription Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from ongoing services or subscriptions providing revenue predictability.
kpis.description: The 10-K does not separately disclose subscription or recurring revenue metrics.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time and part-time employees and contractors of the company.
kpis.description: Total employees increased 4.9% to 4,961 personnel (including full-time, part-time employees and contractors), supporting business growth across regions.
kpis.signal: Controlled headcount growth supporting revenue expansion.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D spending as a percentage of revenue is not separately disclosed in the 10-K financial statements.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital spending for acquisition or upgrade of physical assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are not detailed in the provided 10-K extracts.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €0.61 billion in the most recent year

kpis.name: Net Income (GAAP)
kpis.explanation: Net income of the company under generally accepted accounting principles.
kpis.description: Net income more than doubled from $4.0 million in 2024 to $9.7 million in 2025, driven by revenue growth and other income benefits.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by principal operating activities of the company.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow increased 34.4% from $30.2 million in 2024 to $40.6 million in 2025, showing improved cash conversion.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in cash generation demonstrating operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Number of Customers
kpis.explanation: Total number of active customers served by the company.
kpis.description: Total number of customers decreased from 264 in 2024 to 237 in 2025 as a result of portfolio rationalization efforts focused on non-strategic customer accounts.
kpis.signal: Customer base rationalization focusing on strategic accounts.

risks.title: Foreign exchange fluctuation exposure
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of Item 1A with moderate language ('exposed to', 'may affect'). Exposure increased: 49.7% of expenses in foreign currencies in 2025 vs 43.2% in 2024. Macro-economic category with moderate weight. New potential exposures in Argentine pesos and Serbian dinars mentioned.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on recent acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified mid-section with forward-looking language ('may become materially exposed'). New exposures in Argentina and Serbia following recent acquisitions. Macro category with moderate weight. New trend related to geographic expansion.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not have significant mentions related to artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided extracts.
